_comment: Statuses written by scripts/audit_set_module_status.py at Phase 9 and kept in step with the evidence; see docs/audit/MOP_AUDIT_TRACKER.md. Scripts (the 52 files in scripts/) are operational tooling: those created by the audit are marked as such, the rest are not audited.

app/mop_reco/erp.py.evidence: 34 unit tests (tests/test_erp.py): three layers of read-only, statement guard refuses INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/DDL/COPY/CALL/SELECT INTO/data-modifying WITH/multi-statement/EXPLAIN ANALYZE, password never in describe() or errors. Live privilege audit on the real ERP login: not superuser, no write right on any table, no CREATE right.
app/mop_reco/erp.py.findings: bandit B608 on erp_source/erp_ingest: view names are module constants, not user input (false positive).

app/mop_reco/erp_source.py.evidence: 12 unit tests; 214-date shadow run on the live ERP (POS) and 150,947 vouchers (PTC) agree with the Excel-derived warehouse; half-open date range, no function on the date column (DBA rule) asserted by test.

app/mop_reco/erp_shadow.py.evidence: 10 unit tests; end-to-end against a stand-in PostgreSQL (agrees on matching data, fails and names bill+gateway on a changed reference, names voucher on a changed amount); aggregation rewritten from ~100 s to ~8 s per 50,000-line day; ran 214 dates on live data.

app/mop_reco/erp_ingest.py.evidence: 12 unit tests (cache, re-read window, stale partition removal, baseline copy, PTC) pass. NOT yet exercised on live data: the first ERP-sourced run is pending.
app/mop_reco/erp_ingest.py.findings: Live behaviour (time of the first full pull, memory, run #3 vs run #2) unverified.

app/mop_reco/auth.py.evidence: 19 unit tests (hashing, lock-out, session idle/absolute expiry, last-admin guard, audit trail, MOP_AUTH=off refused in production); verified in a browser on a throw-away database.
app/mop_reco/auth.py.findings: Served over plain HTTP; only two roles; no per-IP throttling (lock-out is per account).

app/auth_gate.py.evidence: 7 source-level gate tests + browser verification of sign-in, refresh, sign-out, forced password change, non-admin refusal.
app/auth_gate.py.findings: Cookie cannot be HttpOnly (script-set); 2 silent broad handlers (ip lookup, cookie read) are harmless but unlogged.

app/mop_reco/masters_db.py.evidence: 16 unit tests; production import verified by read-back; version history and restore tested.
app/mop_reco/masters_db.py.findings: 3 handlers flagged silent by the inventory (lines 97, 157, 397) - to be read in Phase 3.

app/mop_reco/r1_bill_txn.py.evidence: Independent oracle written from the spec: 16 hand-asserted + 300 random collision scenarios agree (tests/test_audit_r1_oracle.py); live re-performance on 5.58M lines
app/mop_reco/r1_bill_txn.py.findings: D-003 (un-deduplicated Paytm frame gave an obscure error) fixed

app/mop_reco/r1_chunked.py.evidence: Full-range parity: 5,584,483 bill lines compared line by line against the per-row engine, 0 differences (CLAUDE.md 6.38); production run identical on 228 dates

app/mop_reco/store_sheet.py.evidence: Whole-paise recomputation of C, G, K, M, N, carry-forward and store start (89 tests); live identities on 45,580 store-days

app/mop_reco/store_sheet_source.py.evidence: Live and persisted figures agree; UAT cases S02, S10, S12, S19
app/mop_reco/store_sheet_source.py.findings: D-001, D-002, D-011 fixed; the slow legacy path (build) is still used by exports and is slow

app/mop_reco/store_sheet_export.py.evidence: tests/test_store_sheet.py (five tabs, live formulas); string-as-formula guard added

app/mop_reco/cms_blocks.py.evidence: Whole-paise reference vs model: 88 tests; three structural controls hold over 225 stores x 228 days (UAT C02)

app/mop_reco/cms_blocks_export.py.evidence: UAT C06: 14,329 live formula cells in the April workbook
app/mop_reco/cms_blocks_export.py.findings: No dedicated unit test of the workbook; S-4 guard added

app/mop_reco/cms_reco.py.findings: Not examined in this audit (CMS Reco page uses cms_blocks)

app/mop_reco/float_tracker.py.evidence: Independent streak, threshold boundary and four years of calendar rules: 81 tests; live float grid identical on 45,580 store-days

app/mop_reco/mop_matrix.py.evidence: Matrix engine verified by UAT S01-S09 and S19
app/mop_reco/mop_matrix.py.findings: D-011 (matched bills with unknown payment mode stayed receivable) fixed

app/mop_reco/manual_match.py.evidence: Concurrency (2 racing operators), atomicity under forced failure, UAT E03-E08
app/mop_reco/manual_match.py.findings: D-005 (two silent warehouse reads) now logged

app/mop_reco/bulk_accept.py.evidence: Atomicity proven; UAT E09 applies and refuses correctly
app/mop_reco/bulk_accept.py.findings: D-011: validated without the payment mode (fixed)

app/mop_reco/exception_pairing.py.findings: D-011: the pool dropped the payment mode (fixed)

app/mop_reco/exception_tables.py.evidence: One column definition for screen, export and upload; UAT E13; round-trip test

app/mop_reco/exceptions.py.evidence: Deterministic keys, remark history (UAT E12), register integrity checks on the live database

app/mop_reco/refunds.py.evidence: Rules by test (tests/test_refunds.py, test_lifecycle.py); atomic apply
app/mop_reco/refunds.py.findings: D-004 fixed (a failed store-master read became an empty master). The folder-import rules were read, not exercised on the real folder

app/mop_reco/table_upload.py.evidence: Atomic apply proven (mixed matches, refunds, remarks)

app/mop_reco/uploads.py.evidence: Validation tests (type, month, missing column), delete and archive tests
app/mop_reco/uploads.py.findings: S-5 (P1) fixed; S-6 zip guard. A real file picker and the large-file fast path were not exercised in UAT

app/mop_reco/upload_prefetch.py.evidence: Hostile-input test: parameters bound, nothing injected (C-005 disproved)

app/mop_reco/queries.py.evidence: The paths UAT uses return figures equal to SQL

app/mop_reco/store_tasks.py.evidence: Tiles, search, closure on match verified (UAT T01, T02, T04); reply never closes a task (tests)
app/mop_reco/store_tasks.py.findings: D-005 (CMS dates read now logged); not read line by line

app/mop_reco/lifecycle.py.evidence: Read in full (40 lines); idempotent closure sync; tests

app/mop_reco/masters.py.evidence: Tests; alias NLD to NEG; schema guard

app/mop_reco/master_gaps.py.evidence: UAT Z04: unresolved identifiers listed by name

app/mop_reco/ingest.py.evidence: D-001 found and fixed here; POS, Paytm, Axis, Bajaj, PTC and CMS proven by full-run comparison; gateway arithmetic checked

app/mop_reco/runs.py.evidence: Proven by the full production run and its comparison (CLAUDE.md 6.39)
app/mop_reco/runs.py.findings: A run was not started in this audit; failure handling read only

app/mop_reco/run_coverage.py.evidence: Readiness per month by test; banner behaviour seen on every page

app/mop_reco/pos_completeness.py.evidence: Flagged the cut-off November file (209,757 of 1,187,732 bill numbers missing) on every page

app/mop_reco/parking.py.findings: Not exercised: Axis data is present, so nothing is parked

app/mop_reco/db.py.evidence: Schema, constraints and live integrity checks passed (Phase 3)
app/mop_reco/db.py.findings: O-2 (no unique key on bill lines), O-3 (redundant indexes), O-4 (table growth)

app/mop_reco/formatting.py.evidence: Date and money formats scanned on every page (UAT Z02)
app/mop_reco/formatting.py.findings: O-7: counts are grouped the Western way, money the Indian way

app/mop_reco/r3a_store_cash.py.findings: Not used by the application pages (the live cash book is store_sheet); kept for a script and tests

app/dashboard_common.py.evidence: UI audit at 375, 768, 1366, 1920 px; chrome tests
app/dashboard_common.py.findings: D-008, D-009, D-010, S-3, S-1-related fixed

app/inline_match.py.findings: Kept in the tree but no page uses it (CLAUDE.md 6.9c-ii); not examined

app/masters_editor.py.findings: The editing screen was not exercised in UAT

app/match_strip.py.evidence: UAT S07: strips add up and flag a mismatch

app/run_panel.py.findings: UAT R01 not run: the Run section changes the database
